candidates.angle: dambhena, pretence, turns ritual into a show
yajanate, they perform ritual, hollowed out by arrogance
dhanamana, wealth-pride and honor-pride, the source of the decay

angle_hi: दम्भेन: दिखावा कर्म को खोखला कर देता है

en.intro: If you see someone performing elaborate rituals, how do you know if the act is pure? Krishna names the warning signs hidden inside the act itself. Listen for the mask.
en.notice: Listen to dambhena, pretence. They perform rituals in name only, without proper method, and with arrogance. The outer action remains, while the inner sincerity is missing.
en.next: Those who act from ego and anger hate Me, who dwell in their bodies and in the bodies of others, and they find fault with My qualities.
en.meaning: Self-important, stubborn, drunk on wealth and praise, they perform ritual in name only, with pretence and without proper method.

hi.intro: अगर आप किसी को बड़े-बड़े यज्ञ करते देखें, तो कैसे पता चलेगा कि वह कर्म सच्चा है? कृष्ण उस कर्म के भीतर छिपे चेतावनी के संकेतों का नाम लेते हैं। छलावा सुनिए।
hi.meaning: अपनेको सबसे अधिक पूज्य माननेवाले, अकड़ रखनेवाले तथा धन और मानके मदमें चूर रहनेवाले वे मनुष्य दम्भसे अविधिपूर्वक नाममात्रके यज्ञोंसे यजन करते हैं
hi.notice: दम्भ से, यानी दम्भेन, दिखावे से। ये लोग अकड़ और धन के मद में चूर होकर कर्म करते हैं, जिसमें कोई विधि नहीं होती। बाहर कर्म दिखता है, पर अंदर का भाव खोखला होता है।
hi.next: जो लोग अहंकार, बल और क्रोध में आकर मेरी विशेषताओं को दोष देते हैं, वे मुझसे ही नफरत करते हैं और मुझे सताते हैं, क्योंकि मैं उन्हीं के और दूसरों के शरीर में भी हूँ।

issues: unsupported: "जो अपने आपको सबसे अधिक पूज्य मानते हैं" (The source Hindi translation uses 'अपनेको' (oneself), which is a literal Sanskrit-derived term. The script changes it to 'अपने आपको', adding the reflexive pronoun 'आप' (you), which is an unsupported addition.)

meaning_changed: "अविधिपूर्वक नाममात्र के यज्ञों से यजन करते हैं" (The source translation says 'अविधिपूर्वक नाममात्रके यज्ञोंसे यजन करते हैं' (perform rituals with name-only sacrifices without proper method). The script says 'नाममात्र के यज्ञों से यजन करते हैं', which drops the explicit 'अविधिपूर्वक' (without proper method) and incorrectly places 'अविधिपूर्वक' before 'यज्ञों'. This changes the meaning of how the ritual is performed.)

wrong_fact: "Listen to dambhena, pretence. The proud perform rituals in name only, with no true method. The outer action remains, but the inner sincerity is replaced by arrogance and show." (The source verse explicitly states they perform rituals 'without proper method' (avidhipūrvakam). The notice contradicts this by saying 'no true method' (which is a paraphrase) but then immediately says 'The outer action remains, but the inner sincerity is replaced by arrogance and show.' The source says the inner sincerity is missing ('in name only'), not replaced by arrogance. However, the main factual error is in the 'next' field: the source says they 'hate Me, who dwell in their own bodies and in the bodies of others, and they find fault with My qualities,' but the Hindi 'next' says 'वे मुझसे ही नफरत करते हैं, क्योंकि मैं उन्हीं के और दूसरों के शरीर में भी हूँ' (They hate me because I am also in the bodies of others). The source does not say 'because' (क्योंकि) they hate Him; it states they hate Him AND find fault with His qualities. The 'because' implies the reason for the hatred is His presence in others, which is not in the source.)

wrong_fact: "जो लोग अहंकार, बल और क्रोध में आकर मेरी निंदा करते हैं" (The Hindi 'next' verse describes people hating Krishna and finding fault with His qualities (verse 18), but it incorrectly states that these people 'denounce' (निंदा करते हैं) Him, which is a factual deviation from the source.)
